info.title: Free Summit booking requests
info.description: Send a booking request for a guided outdoor activity near Lisbon (rock climbing, via ferrata, hiking) on behalf of a client, without filling in the website form. This creates a REQUEST, not a confirmed booking: Free Summit replies to the client's email within 24 hours with availability and the price, and the booking is confirmed when the client replies to accept. Human-readable docs: https://freesummitpt.com/api/

get.summary: Check the service is up and get the link to this description.

post.summary: Send a booking request for one activity.
post.description: Google Apps Script answers with an HTTP 302 redirect; follow it with a GET (curl -L does) to read the JSON result. The HTTP status is always 200: check the 'ok' field.

email.description: Client's email. Free Summit replies here.

phone.description: Client's phone or WhatsApp, with country code. Optional.

enum: Rock climbing at Fenda da Arrábida

type.description: Shared group: Other people can join the same session; Private: Only the client's own group, with the guide.

transfer.description: Transport. No transfer: Client meets the guide at the meeting point; From Lisbon: Transfer from Lisbon; From the south bank: Transfer from the south bank of the Tagus; Cascais station pick-up: Pick-up at Cascais train station; Private transfer: Private transfer.

message.description: Anything else: experience, children's ages, morning or afternoon, questions. Optional.

lang.description: Language Free Summit should reply in.

agent.description: Name of the AI agent or app sending the request, e.g. 'Claude'. Optional but appreciated.

x-activities.summary: Guided outdoor rock climbing at Guia, Cascais. No experience needed. Guide, climbing shoes, all gear and insurance included. From €40 per person.

x-activities.value: Rock climbing at Fenda da Arrábida
x-activities.summary: Guided rock climbing at the Fenda da Arrábida, above Portinho da Arrábida. Beginners and experienced climbers. Guide, climbing shoes, all gear and insurance included. From €50 per person.

x-activities.value: Rock climbing at Forte do Cavalo (Sesimbra)
x-activities.summary: Guided sport climbing on the sea cliffs of Forte do Cavalo, Sesimbra. Beginners and experienced climbers. Guide, climbing shoes, all gear and insurance included. From €50 per person.
Guided via ferrata at Pinheirinhos, Sesimbra: 800 m along the sea cliffs of Arrábida. No climbing experience needed. Guide, gear and insurance included. From €60 per person.
Guided half-day hike in the Serra da Arrábida Natural Park, near Lisbon. Ridges, sea views and Mediterranean scrub. Guide and insurance included. From €30 per person.
Guided half-day coastal hike at Cabo da Roca, the westernmost point of mainland Europe, in the Sintra-Cascais Natural Park. Guide and insurance included. From €30 per person.
Guided half-day hike in the Serra de Sintra: misty forests, granite boulders and views over the palaces and the Atlantic. Guide and insurance included. From €30 per person.

x-activities.value: Climbing course: Introduction to sport climbing
x-activities.summary: 4-day introduction to sport climbing near Lisbon, in Arrábida, Sesimbra, Cascais and Sintra. Learn to lead, belay and climb on your own safely. Minimum 2 people. Guide, gear and insurance included. From €250 per person.

4-day multipitch climbing course in Cabo Espichel, Sintra and Santa Luzia. Build belay stations, manage the rope and abseil safely. For climbers who already lead sport routes. Minimum 2 people. From €290 per person.
